author: birdybro (GitHub; MiSTer contributor)
what_it_is: birdybro's own MiSTer save of Kirby's Adventure, from a zip of their whole MiSTer saves folder (file dated 2021-08-28).
note: MiSTer NES core (2021-22 build). The core wrote 32 KiB (64 SD sectors): the game's 8 KiB of PRG-RAM, then 24 KiB of whatever was in that SDRAM region. birdybro's explanation in the thread: iNES 1.0-headered ROMs give 32 KiB files, NES 2.0-headered ROMs (which declare the PRG-RAM size) give 8 KiB; NES.sv agrees (save_sz, the last LBA written, is 63, i.e. 64 sectors, unless the NES 2.0 prg_nvram field says 8 KiB, then 15). Inside the zip of birdybro's whole MiSTer saves folder; path in the zip: NES/<name>. ROM named with the older '(Rev A)' tag, No-Intro '(Rev 1)'. Here the last 24 KiB are not zero: leftover memory, not save data (23588 non-zero bytes).
